en.headline: Hang Seng Index drops more than 600 points by midday
en.dek: The benchmark fell below 23,000 points in the morning session as technology and financial shares weighed on the market.
body: The Hang Seng Index fell more than 600 points by midday on Thursday, dropping below the 23,000 level. By around 12:22 HKT the index was down 679 points at 22,972, according to market data.

The previous close on Wednesday was 23,651.87. Technology shares and major financials led the decline, with the Hang Seng Tech Index also under pressure. Analysts pointed to softer hopes for strong mainland stimulus after recent Chinese economic data.
Trading remained heavy in the morning. The index had briefly traded as low as the mid-22,900s. A full-day close is not yet available.
Mainland markets were also weaker, with the Shanghai Composite down about 1 per cent at the half.

zh.headline: 恒生指數半日跌逾600點失守23000點
zh.dek: 港股周四上午重挫，科技及金融股拖累，恒指半日報約22972點，較上日收市跌近680點。
body: 恒生指數周四半日跌逾600點，失守23000點關口。截至約中午12時22分，恒指報22972點，下跌679點。
周三收市為23651.87點。科技股及大型金融股成為主要沽壓來源，恒生科技指數同步走弱。市場人士指，內地最新經濟數據令強刺激預期降溫。
上午交投活躍，指數曾低見22900點附近。全日收市數字仍待公布。
內地股市亦偏軟，上證指數半日跌近1%。
